description: Deploy instructions, bootstrap unknown legacy provenance, monitor structural drift, and expose reasons for agent and human review
rationale: The project must serve arbitrary existing repositories whose humans may change source without intent updates; agents need evidence-backed workflows rather than invented historical reasons
requirements: Install a standalone intentctl under a user prefix without runtime dependencies or copying the engine into target repositories
Preserve existing agent instructions and reference a separately reviewable INTENT.md protocol
Treat existing unbound code as unknown provenance and expose an incremental adoption backlog
Detect committed changes that bypassed hooks as well as staged, unstaged, and untracked changes without modifying the repository
Provide foreground monitoring and provider-independent reconciliation task packets for agents
Expose recorded reasons, binding verification, and reassessment needs in human-readable Markdown and JSON
Retain per-binding transitions, required after-byte intent coverage, immutable baselines, and separate verification claims
title: Adopt and monitor existing repositories with locally installed commands
